title: Architecture decision record
description: One decision, as `.ai/decisions/ADR-NNN-<slug>.md` or as an inline entity block. `supersedes` and `superseded_by` are the pair `doctor` follows to find a deprecated record with no successor (CTX-014). This schema does not require `superseded_by`, because a deprecated decision that nothing replaced is a finding worth reporting, not a document that should fail to parse.

status.description: `accepted` is the only status that binds. The others describe a record that is not in force.
